about: Reference items for grading protocol extraction: the eligibility criteria of four protocols, read by hand. No protocol text is stored: each item has a description in our own words, the physical page, a short pattern that finds its passage in the user's own copy of the PDF and, where a reader may word or cite another of its lines, the key words accepted when an extraction is graded. See README.md.
question: What are the inclusion criteria and the exclusion criteria of the study population?

items.label: age 18 or older at the index date
individual-level prescription, diagnosis and history data for at least 12 months before the index date
type 2 diabetes diagnosis on or before the index date (prescription proxy where diagnoses are incomplete)
items.pattern: diagnosis of T2DM on index date

items.label: exenatide group: one incident (dispensed) exenatide prescription in the study window, after a glucose-lowering drug of another class
BYDUREON group (secondary objective): incident BYDUREON prescription instead
comparator group: one incident glucose-lowering drug prescription that is not a DPP-4 inhibitor or a GLP-1 receptor agonist
type 1 diabetes on the index date, or in baseline without a later type 2 diagnosis
gestational diabetes in baseline or on the index date
polycystic ovarian syndrome with metformin as the only glucose-lowering drug
any cancer on or before the index date, except non-melanoma skin cancer
acute pancreatitis or other disease or disorder of the pancreas on or before the index date
a GLP-1 receptor agonist other than exenatide on or before the index date
a DPP-4 inhibitor on or before the index date (not applied in one sensitivity analysis)
new use of semaglutide or an active comparator in the study period (no same ingredient in the past 10 years)
